SELECT
    round(holiday_avg_daily_sales, 2) AS holiday_avg_daily_sales,
    round(regular_avg_daily_sales, 2) AS regular_avg_daily_sales,
    round(((holiday_avg_daily_sales - regular_avg_daily_sales) / regular_avg_daily_sales) * 100, 2) AS holiday_vs_regular_pct
FROM
(
    SELECT
        avgIf(daily_sales, is_holiday = 1) AS holiday_avg_daily_sales,
        avgIf(daily_sales, is_holiday = 0) AS regular_avg_daily_sales
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            d.DateKey,
            if(d.IsHoliday = 'Yes', 1, 0) AS is_holiday,
            sum(sales_amount) AS daily_sales
        FROM retail.DimDate AS d
        LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT DateKey, SalesAmount AS sales_amount
            FROM retail.FactSales
            UNION ALL
            SELECT DateKey, SalesAmount AS sales_amount
            FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        ) AS s
            ON d.DateKey = s.DateKey
        GROUP BY
            d.DateKey,
            is_holiday
    )
)
